description: Queensland publishes a CSV of rural fire station locations with coordinates and address information. The official package metadata states that some rural brigades do not have a station, so the file is not a census of every brigade. It says the feed is uploaded automatically and available on the 22nd of each month; a GitHub locator app points to the resource and mirrors it as a local CSV. The provider declares CC BY 4.0 and public access without a stated charge. The current CSV link redirected to an S3 object and returned HTTP 200, but its body was deliberately not read. Portal resource metadata still carries a 2018 last-modified value while the package notes were updated in 2024, so actual file freshness is unverified. Coverage is Queensland station points, not staff rosters, vehicle counts, response times or dispatch availability. Simulation use includes placing rural-response facilities in an accessibility model, with road travel and brigade coverage added separately. It complements data-dfes-wa-fire-and-emergency-stations in a different Australian state. No CSV row or station count was inspected.
